customers.description: One row per order-level customer record. customer_id is unique per ORDER, not per person.

columns.customer_id: Key used in orders.customer_id. A returning person gets a new customer_id for each order.
columns.customer_unique_id: Identifies the real person across orders. Use COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) to count people.
columns.customer_zip_code_prefix: First 5 digits of zip code, TEXT with leading zeros.
columns.customer_state: Two-letter Brazilian state code, uppercase, e.g. 'SP', 'RJ'.

orders.description: One row per order. Data covers 2016-09 to 2018-10 only.

columns.order_status: One of: delivered, shipped, canceled, unavailable, invoiced, processing, created, approved. 97% are delivered.
columns.order_purchase_timestamp: Text 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'. Use strftime('%Y', ...) for year, strftime('%Y-%m', ...) for month. SQLite has no YEAR().
columns.order_approved_at: Payment approval time, same text format. May be NULL.
columns.order_delivered_carrier_date: Handed to carrier. May be NULL.
columns.order_delivered_customer_date: Delivered to customer. NULL if not delivered.

order_items.description: One row per item in an order. An order with 3 items has 3 rows. This is the table for sales and revenue.

columns.order_item_id: Item sequence number within the order (1, 2, 3...), not an item key.
columns.price: Item price in BRL, excludes freight. Revenue = SUM(price).
columns.freight_value: Shipping cost in BRL for this item.

order_payments.description: One or more payment rows per order (split payments).

columns.order_id: Joins to orders.order_id. Not unique: several rows per order are possible.
columns.payment_sequential: Sequence of payment methods used for the order.
columns.payment_type: credit_card, boleto, voucher, debit_card, or not_defined.
columns.payment_value: Amount paid in BRL. Sum per order to get the order total paid.

order_reviews.description: Customer reviews, usually one per order.

columns.review_creation_date: Date the review survey was sent.

products.description: Product catalog. Category names are in Portuguese.

columns.product_category_name: Portuguese category, e.g. 'beleza_saude'. Join to product_category_name_translation for the English name. About 13 products have a category with no translation, so use LEFT JOIN when counting everything.
columns.product_name_lenght: Number of characters in the name (column name is misspelled in the data).
columns.product_description_lenght: Number of characters in the description (misspelled in the data).

product_category_name_translation.description: Maps Portuguese category names to English.

geolocation.description: Zip code prefix to latitude/longitude. Many rows per zip prefix.
